stories.title: Anchorage police arrest man accused of firing shots inside Mountain View Community Center
stories.summary: Officers apprehended the man using a Taser following reports of gunfire at the center, police Chief Sean Case said.

stories.title: The Rewind: UAA volleyball ends season on high note, 4A volleyball champion earns national recognition
stories.summary: Also: The weekly scoreboard and a look at the action in the week ahead.

stories.title: Trump appeals to state and federal courts to erase hush money conviction
stories.summary: A federal appeals court is weighing whether it can — or should — intervene in President Donald Trump’s hush money case now that a state appellate court in New York has heard arguments in his quest to get his historic conviction thrown out.

stories.title: What to know about the online banking delays affecting major U.S. banks
stories.summary: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank by total assets, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays.

stories.title: Opinion: Washington’s Arctic ambitions need to come home to Alaska
stories.summary: Investments in Nome, Adak and icebreaking capacity deserve sustained attention as the United States expands its role in Greenland.

stories.title: Opinion: Veterans’ care enters a new era in Alaska
stories.summary: For veterans navigating Alaska’s vast distances, connected medical records can make a difference in access and continuity of care.

stories.title: ‘Sharing my frustration’: Candidates say voter discontent fueled highly competitive legislative races in Mat-Su
stories.summary: Five races for seats in the Alaska Legislature representing parts of the deep-red Matanuska-Susitna region are set to be determined by ranked choice tabulation.

stories.title: Lawsuit over Arctic offshore oil prospect says resurrection of leases was illegal
stories.summary: The lawsuit, filed in federal court, targets the Trump administration’s decision to give Hilcorp more time to plan its development of the Liberty prospect in federal waters of the Beaufort Sea.

stories.title: United Airlines says it has resolved technology issue that delayed departing flights
stories.summary: United said that while some flights were delayed because of the issue, flights that were in the air and flights on its United Express regional network were not impacted.

stories.title: Trump administration gives states another 6 months to implement Medicaid work requirement
stories.summary: The requirement is scheduled to take effect nationally on Jan. 1, and states have been scrambling to put in place the staffing, training and technology to implement it by then.

stories.title: White House weighs next steps for FDA nominee Heidi Overton, who faces bipartisan pushback
stories.summary: Heidi Overton’s nomination has faced an uphill battle as some in the GOP, many Democrats and prominent Make America Health Again supporters have questioned or opposed her candidacy.

stories.title: 5 hurt, including child, in multi-vehicle collision on Glenn Highway, Anchorage police say
stories.summary: An SUV crossed the median into southbound traffic Monday morning and collided with two other vehicles, according to a police update.
